categories.name: Treasure Chests & Item Pickups
categories.note: Every optional item pickup in KH Final Mix (chests, clams, event and puzzle rewards), grouped by world, per the KH Fandom item-locations list. Where Final Mix changed a chest's contents, the Final Mix item is shown and the vanilla item is noted. The Treasure Hunter trophy needs 100 chests opened (there are far more than 100). Jungle Slider rewards are tracked under Minigames.

items.name: Potion
items.location: Sora’s Heart — Follow the tutorial instructions after reaching the third station, then simply pick up the dropped Potion after destroying the large crate.
items.note: Missable: Destiny Islands/the prologue cannot be revisited after leaving.

items.name: Potion
items.location: Seashore — Gained as a reward by defeating Riku, as well as defeating Selphie, Wakka, and Tidus in a single fight.
items.note: Missable: Destiny Islands/the prologue cannot be revisited after leaving.

items.name: Hi-Potion or Potion
items.location: Seashore — Gained as a reward from Kairi after collecting all the required items. Note that the reward gets downgraded into a Potion, or even nothing at all, if you talk to her prior to collecting all items and answer anything but "It's all under control."
items.note: Missable: Destiny Islands/the prologue cannot be revisited after leaving. Missable: answer Kairi only after collecting all items.

items.name: Pretty Stone
items.location: Cove — Received as a reward everytime you beat Riku in a race.
items.note: Missable: Destiny Islands/the prologue cannot be revisited after leaving.

items.name: Protect Chain
items.location: Cove — In the cove area is a wooden crate next to the watchtower. Lift it up and drop it below the cave entrance in the cliff wall on the left of the tower, then jump on-top and enter it to find a chest.
items.note: Missable: Destiny Islands/the prologue cannot be revisited after leaving.

items.name: Postcard
items.location: Item Shop — Attack the ceiling fan in the Item Shop once or twice to receive the item.

items.name: Mythril Shard
items.location: Accessory Shop — Inside a chest on a shelf next to the counter inside Cid's Accessory Shop.

items.name: Postcard
items.location: First District — Head up the stairs past the Accessory Shop and turn right to find a bunch of crates. Push the largest one against Cid's shop, then use it to reach the roof with the chest. The crate disappears later, but the chest can still be acquired using the High Jump ability later on.

items.name: Postcard
items.location: Second District — Inside a chest, atop the store awning immediately to the right upon entering the district. Can be reached by using the nearby corner lantern as a step-up to catch onto the awning, or later on with High Jump.

items.name: Mega-Potion
items.location: Second District — Inside a chest on a ledge on the front side of the Gizmo Shop. Reach the ledge by heading to the structure's front door, then jump around the corner and use a mid-air attack to extend your distance and reach the chest.

items.name: Potion
items.location: Alleyway — Upon entering the alleyway, turn left, and left again, to find the chest placed among a few objects.

items.name: Pretty Stone
items.location: Alleyway — Carry one of the crates next to the previous chest to the corner of the hotel building, then use it to climb onto the ledge next to the balcony for another chest.

items.name: Potion
items.location: Alleyway — Located on the far-most balcony, can be reached after the previous item by jumping across each balcony.

items.name: Elixir
items.location: Green Room — Available after fighting Leon, talk to Yuffie to learn about locks, then open the chest on the table

items.name: Mythril
items.location: Green Room — In the same room, hit the green clock above the door leading into the Red Room until a reward sound is heard, which signifies the reveal of a chest on-top of the dresser on the other side of the room.

items.name: Mega-Potion
items.location: First District — Only obtainable prior to entering the Third District after fighting Leon, talk to Aerith for a free Mega-Potion.
items.note: Missable: only obtainable during a limited story window.

items.name: Postcard
items.location: First District — After the fight with Leon, examine the blue safe nearby the door leading to the Second District.

items.name: Elixir
items.location: First District — Only obtainable by defeating Leon, but is not actually given to you until after defeating the Guard Armor boss, after which Leon, Yuffie, and Aerith gift it to you along with 500 munny.
items.note: Missable: you must win the Leon fight.

items.name: Postcard
items.location: First District — Inside a chest on a balcony above the cafe in the First District, requires the use of Trinity Jump.

items.name: Pretty Stone
items.location: Red Room — In a chest inside the Hotel's Red Room.

items.name: Mythril Shard
items.location: Second District — Inside a chest on-top of a roof overlooking the alley to the Third District. Reach the roof by using the Gizmo Shop's exit, then climbing the ladder, from there jump across the rooftops to reach it. The ladder is present earlier, but only available to be climbed after beating Guard Armor.

items.name: Postcard
items.location: Third District — Found by examining a seemingly empty corner on a balcony in the Third District, which is reached by jumping through a hole in a wall above the rooftops in the Second District, where you found the previous item.

items.name: Defense Up
items.location: First District — Available after acquiring Blizzard from Wonderland, use it to extinguish all four candles in the café in time to unlock the nearby chest on the window ledge.

items.name: Dalmatian Puppies 4-6
items.location: Alleyway — Only accessible after using Trinity Charge on the red Trinity Mark inside the alley in First District, which unlocks a shortcut to the Alleyway.

items.name: Dalmatian Puppies 10-12
items.location: Secret Waterway — Only accessible after using Trinity Charge in the Alleyway to enter the Secret Waterway, located in a chest near the stairs.

items.name: Postcard ×2
items.location: Gizmo Shop — Use Thunder on the exposed wiring in Third District, then use the moved platforms in the Gizmo Shop to activate the three buttons on the upper walkways. Examine the clock in the center of the room after it stops moving to obtain two Postcards.

items.name: Dalmatian Puppies 7-9
items.location: Item Workshop — Inside the left chest on a table in the Item Workshop.

items.name: Mythril Shard
items.location: Item Workshop — Inside the right chest on a table in the Item Workshop.

items.name: Postcard
items.location: Item Workshop — Examine the note on the wall behind the left-most Moogle.

items.name: Postcard
items.location: Geppetto's House — Available after clearing Monstro, examine the last item on the shelf.

items.name: Wishing Star
items.location: Geppetto's House — Inside the only chest in the house.

items.name: Spellbinder
items.location: Magician's Study — Talk to Merlin after learning all types of magic.

items.name: Dalmatian Puppies 1-3
items.location: Magician's Study — Requires Glide; use it to reach the chest in the distance behind Merlin's house.

items.name: Camping Set
items.location: Rabbit Hole — Only available prior to presenting the evidence, return to the first area from the Bizarre Room and defeat all the enemies to cause a chest to spawn.
items.note: Missable: only obtainable during a limited story window.

items.name: Camping Set
items.location: Lotus Forest — Gift an Ether to the first red flower on the right for a Camping Set.

items.name: Hi-Potion
items.location: Lotus Forest — Gift a potion to the yellow flower on the right side, past the red one, for a Hi-Potion.

items.name: Footprints
items.location: Lotus Forest — Piece of evidence, located behind the tall gras on the right, next to the yellow flower.

items.name: Camping Set
items.location: Lotus Forest — Gift another Ether to the second red flower on the other side of the forest for another Camping Set.

items.name: Antenna
items.location: Lotus Forest — Second piece of evidence, on-top of a platform next to the boulder blocking the passage to the Tea Party Garden, at the other side of the forest.

items.name: Scan-G
items.location: Lotus Forest — Atop the previous item's platform, look along the right wall to spot a blue chest, you can just barely reach the platform by jumping off the edge.
items.note: Final Mix contents (vanilla KH1 had: Thunder-G).

items.name: Dalmatian Puppies 16-18
items.location: Lotus Forest — Inside a chest on a platform in the center of the room.

items.name: Stench
items.location: Bizarre Room — Climb the platforms in the forest to find a gap into a tree trunk, which drops you above the stove in the Bizarre Room with an evidence box nearby.

items.name: Claw Marks
items.location: Bizarre Room — Inside the Lotus Forest, approach the yellow flower that offers to make you grow and trade it the required potion, then step onto the tree stump, which causes a platform to appear. Hit the hazelnut off the tree branch, and the tree itself, and eat it to shrink again. Next, climb up the new platform to enter a passage in the wall to end up in the Bizarre Room again. You will land atop a faucet, with the evidence box on a nearby shelf, which you can just barely reach with a jump.

items.name: Defense Up
items.location: Bizarre Room — Climb the platforms in the forest, then use the tree branch, after rotating it once, to reach another hole in the wall behind it that leads to the wall above the bed in the Bizarre Room. In here, light the first sconce to cause the chest with the Defense Up to pop out of the wall decoration.

items.name: Mythril Shard
items.location: Bizarre Room — On the same wall, hit the shelf with the teddy bear to make it fall down, and turn a book three dimensional. Read it after growing to your full size to obtain the Shard inside of it.

items.name: Hi-Potion
items.location: Lotus Forest — On the same wall as where the previous items were acquired, light the second sconce to fill in the painting, then examine it to enter a secret area. In here, give a Potion to the right flower for a Hi-Potion.

items.name: Mythril Shard
items.location: Lotus Forest — Inside the same secret area, give an Elixir to the left flower for a Hi-Potion.

items.name: Mega-Potion
items.location: Lotus Forest — In Lotus Forest use the growth flower to return to your full size and then push the new rock into the pond, letting you access a new area that was previously inaccessible. Shrink back down to enter it, then give a Hi-Potion to the red flower for a Mega-Potion.

items.name: Meteor-G
items.location: Queen's Castle — After the first bossfight, return to the Bizarre Room through the same hole used to find the Claw Marks' evidence box. This time you will land atop the wall, where you must hit the faucet to cause a pot on the floor to turn 3D. Enter it to end up in the Queen's Castle, atop a hedge with the chest.
items.note: Final Mix contents (vanilla KH1 had: Dalmatian Puppies 58-60).

items.name: Dalmatian Puppies 13-15
items.location: Queen's Castle — Enter the area that became accessible after pushing the rock and go through the passage in the wall to land on-top of the hedge in the corner of Queen's Castle with another chest.
items.note: Final Mix contents (vanilla KH1 had: Aero-G).

items.name: Potion
items.location: Tea Party Garden — Only accessible after Alice has been kidnapped, sit on each of the chairs around the table to cause enemies or items to spawn. Going counterclockwise, starting at the painting, the first chair on its left (green man's side) releases a Potion, and several HP orbs.

items.name: Potion
items.location: Tea Party Garden — The next chair drops another Potion, and MP orbs.

items.name: Ether
items.location: Tea Party Garden — The next chair drops an Ether, and more MP orbs.

items.name: Potion
items.location: Tea Party Garden — The center chair spawns enemies, but the one next to it drops a Potion and munny

items.name: Elixir
items.location: Tea Party Garden — The following chair spawns enemies again, but the last one drops orbs of all kinds, and an Elixir.

items.name: Dark Matter
items.location: Tea Party Garden — Earlier you could light several lamps on the wall of the Bizarre Room, while here you could also hit the shelf with the teddy bear, which caused it to drop down. While at full size, move the teddy bear, then move the clock after it pops out of the wall. Shrink yourself, then go through the hole that was hidden behind it to emerge on the balcony in the garden.
items.note: Final Mix contents (vanilla KH1 had: Aeroga-G).

items.name: Thundara-G
items.location: Queen's Castle — While on the ceiling of the Bizarre Room, head for the latch on the far side of the wall from the entrance you used, which leads to the hedge in the Queen's Castle room with another chest.
items.note: Final Mix contents (vanilla KH1 had: Dalmatian Puppies 13-15).

items.name: Potion ×2
items.location: Bizarre Room — Lighting the lamps on the ceiling will also turn one of the flowers on the floor 3D, which when examined will drop several items and health orbs.
items.note: Final Mix contents (vanilla KH1 had: Mythril Shard).

items.name: Mega-Potion
items.location: Rabbit Hole — Only available after presenting the evidence and prior to rescuing Kairi, return to the first area from the Bizarre Room and defeat all the enemies to cause a chest to spawn.
items.note: Missable: only obtainable during a limited story window.

items.name: Thundara-G
items.location: Lotus Forest — Requires Thunder; use it on the arch-shaped plant in in the area on the left side, which requires two small platforms to be climbed to enter.
items.note: Final Mix contents (vanilla KH1 had: Shell-G).

items.name: Dalmatian Puppies 58-60
items.location: Lotus Forest — Requires Thunder; use it on the arch-shaped plant in the secret area with the White Trinity (accessible after lighting the second sconce and entering the painting on the wall).
items.note: Final Mix contents (vanilla KH1 had: Thundara-G).

items.name: Orichalcum
items.location: Lotus Forest — Requires Glide, climb the platforms in the forest nearest the entrance to Queen's Castle, then glide to the one in the other corner, above the pond, for a chest.

items.name: Flare-G
items.location: Tea Party Garden — After the previous item, head through the nearby passage to emerge on a hedge, facing a chest.
items.note: Final Mix contents (vanilla KH1 had: Dalmatian Puppies 19-21).

items.name: Dalmatian Puppies 19-21
items.location: Tea Party Garden — Opposite the previous item.
items.note: Final Mix contents (vanilla KH1 had: Aeroga-G).

items.name: Mythril
items.location: Tea Party Garden — Opposite the previous item as well, on a hedge you can reach with Glide.

items.name: Megalixir
items.location: Rabbit Hole — Only available after rescuing Kairi, return to the first area from the Bizarre Room and defeat all the enemies to cause a chest to spawn.

items.name: Mega-Potion
items.location: Coliseum Gates — Inside a chest, behind the columns to the left of the lobby entrance.

items.name: Holy-G
items.location: Coliseum Gates — Requires Blizzara, use the spell to extinguish all the braziers to cause a chest to spawn on the left side. Missable in the original version if you already acquired Blizzaga.
items.note: Final Mix contents (vanilla KH1 had: Firaga-G). Was missable in vanilla KH1; in Final Mix the chest still spawns.

items.name: Shiva Belt
items.location: Coliseum Gates — Requires Blizzaga, use the spell to extinguish all the braziers to cause a chest to spawn on the right side.
items.note: Final Mix contents (vanilla KH1 had: Holy-G).

items.name: Orichalcum
items.location: Coliseum Gates — Inside a unique purple pot to the right of the lobby entrance, hidden behind the pillars. It only appears after completing the Hades Cup.

items.name: Mega-Potion
items.location: Tree House — In a chest, on-top of the net hanging underneath the Tree House, near the base of the tree.

items.name: Protect Chain
items.location: Tree House — On-top of the roof of the Tree House, reach this area by jumping on-top of the broken staircase and then following the walkway around the side of the house until you reach a ladder that leads to the top.
items.note: Final Mix contents (vanilla KH1 had: Protera Chain).

items.name: Mythril
items.location: Tree House — Located inside the rowboat that can be seen hanging from the slanted crow's nest. Reachable by jumping off of the roof, using consecutive mid-air attacks to gain enough distance forwards to land inside.

items.name: Mega-Ether
items.location: Tunnel — In a chest on the platform above the save point.

items.name: Ether
items.location: Camp — Examine the clothesline, then examine the globe next to the tent for the second note. Afterwards head for the table with the chemistry objects and examine them, you need to have a Potion, which you then have to ice (using Blizzard), which results in one Ether.

items.name: Ether ×2
items.location: Camp — After producing a single Ether, examine the gramophone for the third research note. Repeat the experiment, which results in two Ethers now.

items.name: Hi-Potion
items.location: Camp — Examine the grandfather clock, next examine the flagpole. Afterwards examine the stove in the camp, which results in losing a spare Potion. Light the stove using Fire to receive a Hi-Potion in return.

items.name: Mythril Shard
items.location: Tent — Inside the tent.

items.name: Dalmatian Puppies 25-27
items.location: Hippos' Lagoon — In a chest at the far end of the lagoon.

items.name: Mega-Potion
items.location: Hippos' Lagoon — On-top of a tree, on the left side of the lagoon, reachable by a series of simple jumps across two other trees.

items.name: Meteor-G
items.location: Hippos' Lagoon — On-top of a tall tree on the right side of the lagoon, reachable by following a longer series of trees across from the previous chest. Mid-air attacks can help in gaining enough extra distance to cross the longest jump.
items.note: Final Mix contents (vanilla KH1 had: Esuna-G).

items.name: Mythril
items.location: Vines — On the third platform, reachable by swinging across the vines.

items.name: Dalmatian Puppies 28-30
items.location: Vines 2 — Reachable by using the vines to swing to the platform in the distance, from where you can jump to the one with the chest.

items.name: Mega-Potion
items.location: Cliffs — On-top of a taller cliff, reached by climbing a vine.

items.name: Mythril Shard
items.location: Cliffs — Next to the previous item.

items.name: Mythril Shard
items.location: Waterfall Cavern — Upon entering, in a chest on a platform at the other end.

items.name: Dalmatian Puppies 31-33
items.location: Waterfall Cavern — On a smaller ledge opposite the previous item.
items.note: Final Mix contents (vanilla KH1 had: Shell-G).

items.name: Mythril Shard
items.location: Waterfall Cavern — On the higher platform above the Shard chest, opposite and diagonally above the chest with the puppies.

items.name: Orichalcum
items.location: Waterfall Cavern — On the platform opposite the previous item, can be reached by using a vine to climb across the wall.

items.name: Mega-Potion
items.location: Plaza — Facing the main exit, to the right in a corner next to the stall.

items.name: Mega-Ether
items.location: Plaza — Facing the main exit, to the left on-top of a small building.

items.name: Mega-Potion
items.location: Storage — In the Plaza is a single door that leads to a Storage room, the chest is hidden behind a barrel and placed between rolled up carpets.

items.name: Mega-Ether
items.location: Main Street — Inside a chest in the north-east corner, accessible by climbing up to Aladdin's House, then by jumping down from the large red awning.

items.name: Mega-Potion
items.location: Alley — Available after encountering Jafar in the Alley, can be found in a chest on the same platform where he stood.

items.name: Megalixir
items.location: Aladdin's House — Inside a green chest next to the save point.

items.name: Scissors-G
items.location: Aladdin's House — Inside a green chest next to a hole in the wall.
items.note: Final Mix contents (vanilla KH1 had: Dalmatian Puppies 37-39).

items.name: Cottage
items.location: Plaza — Enter Aladdin's House, release the hidden lock behind the cabinet, then use the exit that looks like a normal doorway. Jump across the window shutters and gaps between rooftops to reach the one in the far corner, where a blue chest hides between two disguised Pot Spiders

items.name: Dark Matter
items.location: Main Street — After the previous item, use the doorway opposite it to enter Main Street, where you can climb two stacked crates to reach a rooftop leading to a ledge with a chest.
items.note: Final Mix contents (vanilla KH1 had: Shell-G).

items.name: Thundara-G
items.location: Bazaar — In a chest on the opposite end after using the Main Street doorway.
items.note: Final Mix contents (vanilla KH1 had: Shell-G).

items.name: Fire Ring
items.location: Bazaar — In another chest on the tallest ledge, on the other side away from the lock.
items.note: Final Mix contents (vanilla KH1 had: Fira Ring).

items.name: Protera Chain
items.location: Palace Gates — Available after the Pot Centipede bossfight, use the upper passage into the Palace Gates area from Main Street and then jump across to the other side of the area using the platforms.

items.name: Mega-Ether
items.location: Entrance — In a red chest on a platform.

items.name: Elixir
items.location: Hall — On-top of the plateau with three stone heads that spray jets of water, climb the left-most to be able to reach it.

items.name: Mythril Shard
items.location: Hall — In an alcove in the far corner of the room, next to the passage to the next area.

items.name: Mega-Potion
items.location: Bottomless Hall — Upon entering the Hall area, turn to the right and jump onto the stone head attached to a pillar, and from there to a platform with another doorway. This leads to a section in the Bottomless Hall area with a chest and a block, which you can push down for easier access to the Mythril in the Relic Chamber.

items.name: Elixir
items.location: Bottomless Hall — To the right upon entering, hard to reach, but a normal jump and mid-air attack to gain a little extra distance is enough.

items.name: Cottage
items.location: Bottomless Hall — On-top of a plateau in the center of the room.

items.name: Defense Up
items.location: Treasure Room — In a green chest on-top of the fireplace.

items.name: Mythril Shard
items.location: Treasure Room — Easy to reach, in a red chest to the right of the previous item.

items.name: Dalmatian Puppies 37-39
items.location: Treasure Room — On a platform above the entrance, jump over from the gold pile with the previous chest.
items.note: Final Mix contents (vanilla KH1 had: Shell-G).

items.name: Thundaga-G
items.location: Treasure Room — Use Abu to 'Call' the gem held up by the right monkey statue, after which Sora is blown onto the gold pile with the chest.
items.note: Final Mix contents (vanilla KH1 had: Dalmatian Puppies 52-54).

items.name: Thunder Ring
items.location: Relic Chamber — Opposite of the stairway, can be reached by swimming.
items.note: Final Mix contents (vanilla KH1 had: Thundara Ring).

items.name: Mythril
items.location: Relic Chamber — To the right of the stairway, can be reached after pushing down a stone block in Bottomless Hall (which in itself is reached through the Hall area), or with a carefully timed jump and mid-air attack.

items.name: Protera Chain
items.location: Dark Chamber — In Relic Chamber, use Abu to 'Call' the gem held up by the monkey statue, then enter the alternate Dark Chamber area to find the chest.
items.note: Final Mix contents (vanilla KH1 had: Protega Chain).

items.name: Meteor-G
items.location: Dark Chamber — While in the same Dark Chamber area as the previous item, swim up the waterfall and 'Call' the second gem to lower the stone wall behind you, with the chest on-top with it.
items.note: Final Mix contents (vanilla KH1 had: Dispel-G).

items.name: Torn Page
items.location: Dark Chamber — Across the water from the previous chest, can be reached by going up the staircase from the water.

items.name: Cottage
items.location: Dark Chamber — In a red chest, opposite the save point. Can be reached with a jump and mid-air attack.

items.name: Mythril
items.location: Main Street — Requires High Jump; located on a tall ledge between the upper passages to the Palace Gates and Bazaar areas.

items.name: Dalmatian Puppies 52-54
items.location: Palace Gates — Requires High Jump; use the upper passage into the Palace Gates area, followed by jumping to the tall ledge in the opposite corner.
items.note: Final Mix contents (vanilla KH1 had: Aeroga-G).

items.name: Haste-2G
items.location: Hidden Room — Technically requires Trinity Push, but can be acquired earlier by using High Jump. Enter the Silent Chamber area in the caverns below and have Abu call the gem in the side passage, opening a door in the Silent Chamber. Using High Jump you can just barely reach the ledge of the revealed passage, then head through to activate another gem, which will open a large gate nearby with two chests, the right one of which contains the gummy item.
items.note: Final Mix contents (vanilla KH1 had: Thundara-G).

items.name: Dalmatian Puppies 46-48
items.location: Hidden Room — Acquired in the same method as the previous item, but is located in the left chest.
items.note: Final Mix contents (vanilla KH1 had: Meteor-G).

items.name: Osmose-G
items.location: Palace Gates — Requires High Jump and Glide; accessible by using the upper passage into the Palace Gates area, then jumping to the highest ledge in the corner on the other side. From there use Glide to reach the corner with the chest on the far side.
items.note: Final Mix contents (vanilla KH1 had: Dalmatian Puppies 46-48).

items.name: Dalmatian Puppies 49-51
items.location: Entrance — Requires High Jump and Glide; in a blue chest on a tall pillar at the end of the Entrance area. Can also be acquired without Glide by using a nearby barrel to reach the platform.

items.name: Mythril Shard
items.location: Meadow — Inside the hollow tree trunk.

items.name: Mega-Ether
items.location: Pooh's House — Hit the chimney on the roof to make a Mega-Ether appear inside the house.

items.name: Elixir
items.location: Pooh's House — Open the cabinet inside Pooh's house to cause an Elixir to fall out.

items.name: Potion / Elixir ×?
items.location: Rabbit's House — Underneath any of the pumpkins and cabbages, actual amount is random.

items.name: Mythril
items.location: Pooh's House — Only available after the Pooh's Swing minigame. Light Pooh's campfire in front of his house when he is sitting nearby to receive a Mythril from him.

items.name: AP Up
items.location: Bouncing Spot — After clearing Tigger's Giant Pot, jump into the hollow tree stump for a chest.

items.name: Mythril
items.location: Bouncing Spot — You can find a Mythril by hitting the center of the hollow log near Pooh.

items.name: Shield2-G
items.location: Bouncing Spot — Have Tigger be your partner on the seesaw, then jump from the tree where you land to the large leafed branch of the tree behind it. There is an item in the hollow interior here, which drops down behind you when you jump inside and slide down.

items.name: Mythril Shard
items.location: Bouncing Spot — Have Tigger be your partner on the seesaw again, then head for the same branch as the previous, and look left for a red chest on a small clifftop.

items.name: Dark Matter
items.location: Bouncing Spot — Ask Roo to be your partner, then jump down from the platform where you land and use a mid-air attack to redirect yourself to the one hidden beneath it for a red chest.

items.name: Power Up
items.location: Bouncing Spot — Received from Owl after handing in the first , which can you grab after asking Roo to be your partner and taking it from the branches above where you land. Note that you can only hold one nut at a time.

items.name: Defense Up
items.location: Bouncing Spot — Received from Owl after handing in the second rare nut, which is located next to the previous one.

items.name: Orichalcum
items.location: Bouncing Spot — Received from Owl after handing in the third rare nut, ask Tigger to be your partner again, and turn right after landing. Jump onto the next two branches, and then the leafy one next to it where the nut is.

items.name: Mythril Shard
items.location: Bouncing Spot — Received from Owl after handing in the fourth rare nut, which is obtained by finding the hollow leg next to the seesaw, and the two circular tree sections on the floor. Step onto the one farthest from the log to cause the other to rise into the air due to a small geyser, use it as a platform to grab the nut.

items.name: AP Up
items.location: Bouncing Spot — Received from Owl after handing in the fifth and final rare nut, which is obtained in a similar manner as the previous one. Head for the other hollow low and press the button next to it, which causes a platform to rise into the air at a faster rate. Use High Jump to climb the nearby tree stump, followed by the platform, and finally the leafy branch with the nut, next to the cliff plateau.

items.name: Mega-Ether
items.location: Chamber 3 — Available early on by entering from Chamber 1, located at the far end of the room.

items.name: Cottage
